IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Monday, October 12, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot with 49 calls and only 257 hands on book—nearly a 1:5 ratio. Two data center reposts are eating slots: Gurtz Electric's Port Washington gig (66 Inside JW, 7:30 AM start) and Cupertino's same facility (30 hands, 7 AM). Microsoft Mount Pleasant Microsoft Data Center round out the picture. All reposts means continuity work if you're patient with orientation.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** sits fat with 60 calls against 481 hands, but here's the play: **$42/hr** is locked across Miller Electrical's QTS Fayetteville run (77 Inside JW, 4-10s + 1-8 Mon-Fri, 6:30 AM start) and their Hampton shop gig (38 hands, 4-10s + 2-8s Saturday included). Whitehead Electric's Fayetteville QTS call mirrors the rates. Four-tens with weekend optionals—this is steady volume work.

**LU-583 El paso, TX** is the outlier gem. Only 7 calls, but Mass Electric's Santa Teresa, New Mexico call hits **$70/hr** (5 Inside JW). That's **all OT double time**. Cupertino's same site runs **$40/hr** plus a fat **$30/hr over-scale premium** ($70 total for JIW from 350+ miles out), with **$1121/week per diem**. Brutal commute, serious check.

**LU-545 St. joseph, MO** has tight boards (45 hands, 7 calls) but Enerfab's Turney Energy Center slot is straight business: **$68.51/hr** (23 Inside JW). RPG's same site adds **$120/day per diem** on top of **$55** base—structure work plays different. Newtron rounds it out at **$68.51**.

**LU-1426 Grand forks, ND** runs 24 calls on 77 hands with Parsons Electric dominating Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood—**$44.8/hr**, 6-10s, **$100/day per diem** (non-taxed) if you're 100+ miles from home. Michels Power's compressor station hits **$200/day per diem** but runs 6-10s in Minnesota.

**LU-20 Dallas, TX** spreads 45 calls across 146 hands: Fisk Electric (NPC Dallas, 20 Inside JW, **$40.65**, 5-8s scattered OT) and Rosendin's MPS Lewisville (10 Inside JW, **$40.65**, 4-10s, orientation 10/20).

Data centers are pulling every available hand north and west; per diem and over-scale premiums are the real compensation story this week.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Monday, October 12, 2026**

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is running hot with 8 calls, 233 hands on the books. Data center work is the backbone here: Cache Valley Electric and ArchKey Sachs both posting Inside JW slots at **$38.25/hr** plus **$15.00/hr over scale** on the Cache Valley gig, with ArchKey throwing in a **$250/day incentive** for day shift completion. Beltline's TVA scale job at **$37.99** hires at 6:45 same-day refer. This is plug-and-play work if you can get in the door.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** sits fat with 39 calls and 149 hands—heavy lineman and substation tech board. Service Electric's Social Circle crew runs **$46.8/hr** plus **$150/day per diem**, but you need Quanta barehand cert; Fairway Electric wants statewide JLs at the same **$46.8/hr** with Class A CDL and URD experience. Inception's substation tech calls pay **$44.46** with **$150/day PD**. The Georgia spread is wide and solid.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 24 calls chasing 77 hands on Parsons Electric's Polaris Forge Data Center push in Harwood—Inside JW slots at **$44.8/hr** with **$100/day per diem** (non-taxed if you're 100+ miles from job site) plus **$100/day incentive Monday-Friday**. Running 6-10s or open call depending on the slot. Michels Power in St. Vincent, MN adds 4 more at **$44.8** with **$200/day per diem**.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** posts 21 calls on 49 hands. Thayer's Woodstock distro/rock drill job hits **$71/hr** with **$125 bonus for 45 hrs, $150 bonus for 55 hrs**—CDL and clean driving record required. LE Myers' Andrews AFB transmission work pays **$55/hr** plus **$150/day PD** (crane cert needed). DC/Maryland infrastructure is moving.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** shows 32 calls chasing 58 hands. ARC American's NW Indiana NISPO distro/sub-transmission gig runs **$63.66/hr** plus **$75/day per diem** (hotels covered) on 5-10s with Class A CDL mandatory. MJ Electric's Ft. Wayne transmission lattice tower work pays **$56.66** plus **$100/day or $175/day** depending on room arrangements.

Data center buildouts and transmission new construction are the current magnets—the board width is solid everywhere, but the premium over-scale money is following the infrastructure megaprojects.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Monday, October 12, 2026**

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is running away with the board: 54 calls, 150 hands needed across Intel Ronler Acres in Hillsboro. Apollo Mechanical's got 17 High Purity Fitters and 16 CAD/BIM Detailers on tool install work with flexible scheduling—foreman scale on the detailer side. Harder Mechanical's running parallel with 14 and 11 more fitters, both flagged for heavy ladder work and walking. This is volume work; if you're book deep here, you're moving.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** has 18 calls hunting 61 hands, nearly all Sego Project work through BCS Mechanical on 4-10s (6:00 AM–4:30 PM, OT included). Fifteen journeyman pipefitters, 13 plumbers, and 5 apprentices—Aug 3 start date means some of these were posted hot. DSI's got 6 journeymen on QTS (Eagle Mountain) running mixed 5-8s and 5-10s at **$10.00** per call. BCS is the play here for volume.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** is tight but spicy: 6 calls, 23 hands total. Kiewit's pushing a CWI (Certified Welding Inspector) position at **$65.00** per diem with **$65** per diem on night shift and 15% differential—that's the high single call on the board. Power Source Services wants 5 combo welders with rigging cert for JM Shafer station in Fort Lupton. US Eng. Metalworks has shop fitters (stainless required) dispatching Tuesday.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** shows 6 calls for 37 hands: Gem's running fab shop welders and pipefitters, Graham needs 4 current-in-DISA pipefitters at Cenovus, CAM's got 7 at Nutrien. DISA currency is the gate here—don't show up without it.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** is skeleton crew (1 call, 12 hands): Four Seasons towers in Henderson, journeyman rates, OSHA 10/30 required, starting 7/30 per the data.

The West's draining Portland and Salt Lake while the industrial heartland (Lima, Denver) stays specialized and credential-locked.
